A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HBO research. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including the new Appendices C–D in v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original multilingual and multitask fine-tuning results in Table 1, with additional ablations and sensitivity experiments in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds baseline comparisons and difficulty-metric experiments in Appendices C–D.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the two-layer actors, hierarchical sampling, policy-gradient updates and reward functions remain unchanged. Appendix D explains the existing difficulty scorer and tests alternative grouping metrics as ablations without revising the proposed HBO procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training sources, eight languages, four multitask domains and nine evaluation tasks. The new appendix experiments retain the existing multilingual coverage rather than introducing new datasets or test scenarios.

E2.justification: Appendix C adds evaluated DMT and EVIC baselines using Llama-3.1-8B in the multilingual setting. All original Table 1 comparators remain, including MoS+, despite removal of its explanatory passage.

E3.justification: Appendix D introduces experimental conditions that group training examples using PPL or loss instead of SuperFiltering. Existing zero-shot evaluation, sampling fractions and Appendix A training settings remain unchanged; the newly named difficulty-scoring model is an implementation disclosure.

E4.justification: Appendix D and Table 9 newly test sensitivity to the metric used for difficulty grouping. This differs from the retained Appendix B experiments varying reward functions. Existing actor, granularity, sampling-prior, data-volume, model-size and update-frequency analyses remain.

E5.justification: Table 1 newly marks all six HBO aggregate scores as significant against the best baseline at p < 0.05, citing Koehn (2004). v2 lacks this reporting. No repeated-run counts, seeds or confidence intervals are added, and additional training runs are not established.

E6.justification: Existing accuracy values in Tables 1–7 and plotted results remain unchanged. Table 8 adds multilingual averages of 45.43 for DMT and 46.10 for EVIC against retained HBO 48.07. Table 9 adds HBO-PPL 47.42 and HBO-Loss 47.23 against Prop. 46.25.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 and the bilevel formulation remain mathematically unchanged. Appendix D spells out the formula for the already-used IFD/SuperFiltering metric; it adds explanation rather than a new mathematical definition, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same hierarchical-sampling contribution, evaluation scope and claims of improved accuracy and adaptive balancing. The new experiments support these existing claims; the added code-release sentence concerns reproducibility.

C2.justification: Appendix D newly interprets the PPL/loss experiments as evidence that local actors can balance groups whenever the metric supplies a meaningful difficulty signal. It also explains difficulty through the help provided by instructional context. Existing result interpretations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix D newly identifies Qwen2.5-0.5B as the difficulty scorer and details IFD calculation; Appendix C discloses baseline reimplementation. Conversely, Section 4.1 removes the MoS+ definition and shared initialization-prior statement. The repository link remains, but v3 inconsistently describes code as released in the abstract and forthcoming upon publication in its reproducibility statement.

R1.justification: v3 adds Dong et al. (2024), Liang et al. (2025) and Koehn (2004), and removes works by Sanh et al., Ruder, Ye et al. and Raffel et al. The central positioning around joint global and local balancing remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited prose edits, updates an author affiliation, switches to author-year citations and adds ethics, reproducibility and LLM-use statements plus Appendices C–D. The main section order and most methodological and analytical prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 8–9 and significance markers with an expanded Table 1 caption. It changes title, heading and page-header styling and reflows existing material, including Table 3. All four figures and the structures of existing tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Appendices C–D modestly strengthen empirical support through additional baselines and a previously untested dependence on the grouping metric. The scorer disclosure and Table 1 significance reporting also help. These gains are limited by sparse statistical details, removal of the MoS+ and shared-prior explanations, and inconsistent code-release wording; they do not constitute a substantial overall advance.
